name: PKG_M3
note: internal package root (com.synexia.m3, org.synexia.m3); a bare com.synexia.m3 is the root itself, never jdk.internal.m3.m3; a word boundary is also a TSV or newline escape (backslash-t, backslash-n) or an underscore before com

name: PKG
note: every other com.synexia / org.synexia package, and a type directly in it (com.synexia.M3Planner); a bare prefix literal "com.synexia." is a check, not a name, and stays

name: PKG_PATH_M3
note: package root as a path

name: PKG_PATH
note: package as a path

name: JNI_M3
note: JNI symbol and javah header name of the package root (Java_com_synexia_m3_X_f, com_synexia_m3_X.h)

name: JNI
note: JNI symbol and javah header name of any com.synexia package

name: PKG_DUNDER_M3
note: package path flattened with __ for a slash (diff and image file names)

name: PKG_DUNDER
note: flattened package path

name: TYPE_M3
note: a type already carrying M3 keeps one M3

name: TYPE
note: type, member and constant prefix (also inside a name: canonicalSynexiaOwner)

name: CONST
note: constant, environment and secret names (a workflow's secrets.SYNEXIA_* span is kept)

name: KEBAB
note: module, artifact, crate and file names

name: SNAKE
note: script, function and key names (check_synexia_x.py, reviewed_synexia_commit)

name: KEBAB_SUFFIX
note: a kebab name ending in the word (check-synexia.py); a snake suffix (dependency_on_synexia) is a statement about the donor and stays

name: CONST_KEBAB
note: invariant and ledger ids (SYNEXIA-LLM-FIRST-2)

name: SEGMENT
note: a whole path segment (m3/vendor/synexia/)

name: SEGMENT_DOT
note: a whole dotted segment (com.m3.synexia.importer, schema id synexia.recipe-source-custody); never a domain name

name: PKG_COM_M3
note: exported M3 packages take the JDK module prefix (Maven groupId spans are kept)

name: PKG_PATH_COM_M3
note: exported package as a path

name: JNI_COM_M3
note: JNI symbol and header name of an exported package

name: PKG_DUNDER_COM_M3
note: flattened exported package path

name: DOUBLE
note: synexia-m3-x renamed once gives m3-m3-x, com.m3.synexia.x gives jdk.m3.m3.x: one prefix or segment (no m3-m3-, m3.m3. or m3/m3/ existed before the rename)

name: PRODUCT_CONST
note: product name in a constant or environment name (M3_JDK21_REFUSE): M3JDK_* (user decision 2026-10-31, per-kind JDK style)

name: PRODUCT_KEBAB
note: product name in a file, artifact or kebab name (m3-jdk21.tar.gz, m3-jdk-proof.yml): m3jdk-*

name: PRODUCT_ID
note: product name in an invariant or ledger id (M3-JDK-PORT-1): M3JDK-*

name: PROSE_PRODUCT_VERSION
note: product name with its version in a comment line (M3jdk21, M3JDK21): M3JDK 21; repository links, paths and PR references stay

name: PROSE_PRODUCT
note: bare product name in a comment line (M3jdk, M3 JDK): M3JDK

name: COPYRIGHT
note: copyright and SPDX lines are kept whole

name: GROUP_ID
note: Maven coordinates are not packages; mapped by the artifact phase

name: SECRET
note: a repository secret is a dependency the standalone check must still see

name: LEGAL_FILE
note: attribution file names are release-boundary files

name: REPOSITORY
note: links to the donor repository stay true links (the standalone check removes dependencies, the rename does not hide them)

name: REPOSITORY_M3JDK
note: the GitHub repository hsoliwal/M3jdk21 keeps its name in every link (user decision 2026-10-31)

name: LEGAL_MD
note: the JDK legal file src/java.base/share/legal/synexia.md is named after the donor, as every legal/<component>.md is

name: LEGAL
note: legal and attribution files keep their names
